text: A good book on the shelf is a friend that always stays by your side.
author: English Proverb

text: Behind the success of a man is the shadow of a woman. But behind the success of anyone is at least one book.
author: Anonymous

text: Reading is important. If you know how to read, the whole world opens up to you.
author: Barack Obama

text: A room without books is like a body without a soul.
author: Marcus Tullius Cicero
